scope: 40 explicitly seed-for-sowing CN8 codes; June 2026 gross intra-EU exporter dispatches, 27 EU reporters; not total EU seed sector or 121-species measured total.
reason: All recovered 40 CN descriptions explicitly restrict use to sowing. Group-level botanical breadth does not make this headline commodity trade; safe CN-based labeling avoids species precision claims. No additional broader/ambiguous-use universe is present, so MODEL_B would be artificial.

headline.label: EU seed-for-sowing trade · 40 CN codes
headline.description: Gross internal-EU dispatches; species-specific, crop-type and customs-group evidence. Coverage is customs-defined, not complete seed-market coverage.
